title: Browser Frame Reveal
description: A polished browser frame rises beside concise positioning copy, ready for a real product screenshot or procedural UI fallback.

defaultProps.title: See the whole picture
defaultProps.subtitle: Turn a product screenshot into a confident, editorial product moment.

title: App Device Showcase
description: A dimensional phone device rotates into view with an app screen, interaction chips, and a clean feature narrative.

defaultProps.title: Your work, in motion
defaultProps.subtitle: Present an app screen as a tactile product reveal with a clear three-step story.

title: Annotation Callouts
description: Three numbered annotation callouts point into a browser screenshot to explain the important UI controls without clutter.

defaultProps.title: Make every control legible
defaultProps.subtitle: Use numbered callouts to explain product behavior at a glance.

title: Before After Wipe
description: A moving split wipe compares a muted before state with a vivid after state and a measurable outcome badge.

defaultProps.title: A clearer experience
defaultProps.subtitle: Show the payoff of a UI redesign with a strong, readable comparison.

title: Focus Zoom Detail
description: A full interface slowly pushes into a highlighted detail region, making a small interaction feel important and cinematic.

defaultProps.title: Find the signal
defaultProps.subtitle: Guide attention from the complete interface into one decisive detail.

title: Cursor Walkthrough
description: A deterministic cursor travels through a browser UI while a compact step rail labels each action in sequence.

defaultProps.title: From click to done
defaultProps.subtitle: Turn a product flow into a simple, easy-to-follow tutorial.

title: Stacked Screens
description: Three browser screens fan into a dimensional stack beside a concise workflow narrative for multi-state product stories.

defaultProps.title: One flow, every state
defaultProps.subtitle: Layer multiple screenshots to show how a workflow evolves from start to finish.

title: Window Chrome Cascade
description: Overlapping desktop-style browser windows cascade into place to establish product context and hierarchy.

defaultProps.title: Context is a feature
defaultProps.subtitle: Show the surrounding windows that make an interface feel real and connected.

title: Evidence Spotlight
description: A pulsing spotlight isolates the key region of a screenshot and labels it as the moment viewers should remember.

defaultProps.title: The moment that matters
defaultProps.subtitle: Use a controlled spotlight to make proof, status, or a result impossible to miss.

title: UI Flow Map
description: Four screenshot states connect into an animated interaction map that communicates a complete user journey.

defaultProps.title: The path is the product
defaultProps.subtitle: Map a multi-screen journey into four clear states with directional handoffs.
